title: Feerootiral yaasi haala
description: Hokkuki bolle nga'al e heɓa ko hewti ko ɓernde AI, bana no ɓoggi ɓoggi ɗin heɓata. Min waaway ɓesda teefooji ɗin (ko wi'etee context size) ngam ɗum heɓa ko ɓuri, amma ɗum waaway naftira ko ɓuri heewtugo nder kompuuta min. Min waaway ɓesda ko ɗum heɓata, laatiiɗum e hoosa goɗɗe taariha hokkuki bolle ngam ɗum heɓa nokkuure ngam lilal kesum.
lastRequestOverflowed: Yelaaki sakitiɗum waɗii ko wi'etee context window ɓeydo.
contextOverflowDetail: Ɗu'um tefuki e yiɗi tokenji {{request}}, amma keeriiji moodel ngal e ngoodi tan {{context}}.
contextOverflowGeneric: Ko ɗum yiɗi ɓuri ko ɗum heɓata.
emptyReply: Moodel ngol timminaaka naa e ɗum hokka jaabaaki. Foondu wadduki, malla foonduye darnde ko hokkata.

engine.unknown: Ɓe wi’i injiniyaarin mbi’ii kaɓɓodiiɗum e nyaamndu.
engine.MODEL_ARCH_NOT_SUPPORTED: Injiniyawol jooni meeɗay jaɓrugo dabareeje ɗe. Jaɓrugo injiniyaaku gila Settinki foti ɓesda jaɓrugo.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_TIMED_OUT: Ɓurna moodelwol ngol heɓii wakkati ɗuɗɗum ngam heɓtoyki nden ɗum saggiti; moodelwol pamarngol malla bote pamarɗum e heɓtoyki.
engine.MISSING_SHARED_LIBRARY: Laabirari ko inji yiɗi walaa, ngam non ɗum waaway fuɗɗaaki.
engine.GPU_DRIVER_TOO_OLD: Your GPU driver ko ɓuri heewde dow injiniya kanka. Waylugo injiniya kanka, maabo waylugo yaago CPU engine nder Settings, waaway wo'itina ɗum.
engine.OUT_OF_MEMORY: Ɓe walaa hakkillo ko ɗuuɗi ngam huuduki e misaaluuji ɗi'i; misaaluuji pamari malla bote pamari ɗe kontekstwol ɓurna fuu e wallita.
engine.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Go'o nder darnde ɗen ɗe foonduye ɗe ngalaa goonga.
engine.IO_ERROR: Binndi nga'al waaway anndeeki malla winndeeki nde fuɗɗoode moodelwol ngol.
engine.INTERNAL_ERROR: Wonnde huunde nde fooɗay nder Novera nde fuɗɗoode suura kan.
engine.ENGINE_UNREACHABLE: Enjin llama.cpp e huuwa amma Novera waawata hawtuki e ɗum dow kompuuta (127.0.0.1). VPN, Proxy maa boo softwaare nastinaaki waaway hawtuki e nokkuure.
engine.ENGINE_STOPPED: Enjin llama.cpp daayii. Dillugo lilal ngol tokkitini fuɗɗuki ɗum; to ɗum tokkitini daayii, sowuki software malla GPU daayiiwal foti laatoo daliila.
engine.UNSUPPORTED_CPU: Ɗuuɗal moodelji ɗin e ɗe njaɓataake nder processor ngal kampitawol ngol. NoveraMaasinji Apple's Local Engine e titaa ngam Apple Silicon Macs ().M1 ko boo ko ɓadiiɗum), ngam non ɗum waaway fuɗɗuki dow Intel Mac. Cloud e ko tabbitinaa ɗum fuu e huuda.

noRunningSession: Wala suudu kuugal heptaaka heptaaka ngam model: {{model}}
serverPortOccupied: Ɗum ɗo mari darnde ɓoɗe ndiyam ɓe ɗo naftira bee man.
serverPortOccupiedDescription: Port {{port}} e huwiraama. To ɓe foonda port feere.
serverInvalidModelPath: Laawol moodel ngol moƴƴaani walla ngol heɓaaka
